select.title: Select Filter
select.description: Dropdown filters that sync selected values to URL search params with debounced updates.
select.currentParamsDesc: URL updates are debounced by {ms}ms after each selection.
select.noParamsHint: No search params set yet. Pick a value above to update the URL.

multiSelect.title: Multiple Select Filter
multiSelect.description: Dropdown filters that sync multiple selected values to URL search params as comma-separated lists.
multiSelect.statusDesc: Writes to the "status" param, e.g. status=active,pending.
multiSelect.categoryDesc: Writes to the "category" param, e.g. category=electronics,books.
multiSelect.tagsDesc: Writes to the "tags" param, e.g. tags=featured,new,on-sale.
multiSelect.currentParamsDesc: URL updates are debounced by {ms}ms after each selection.
multiSelect.noParamsHint: No search params set yet. Pick values above to update the URL.

tabs.title: Tabs Filter
tabs.description: Tabbed filters that sync the selected option to URL search params with a smooth sliding indicator.
tabs.statusDesc: Writes to the "status" search param. "All" clears the filter.
tabs.currentParamsDesc: URL updates are debounced by {ms}ms after each selection.
tabs.noParamsHint: No search params set yet. Pick a tab above to update the URL.

date.title: Date Filter
date.description: Date picker filters that sync selected dates to URL search params in ISO format.
date.fromDesc: Writes to the "from" search param as an ISO datetime (e.g. 2026-07-03T14:21:46.707Z).
date.toDesc: Writes to the "to" search param as an ISO datetime (e.g. 2026-07-03T14:21:46.707Z).
date.currentParamsDesc: URL updates are debounced by {ms}ms after each selection.
date.noParamsHint: No search params set yet. Pick a date above to update the URL.

search.title: Search Filter
search.description: Text search that syncs the query to URL search params with debounced updates.
search.defaultQueryDesc: Writes to the "q" search param by default.
search.customParamDesc: Writes to the "name" search param when paramKey is set.
search.currentParamsDesc: URL updates are debounced by {ms}ms after each keystroke.
search.noParamsHint: No search params set yet. Type in the search field above to update the URL.

limit.title: Limit Filter
limit.description: Select how many rows to show per page, synced to URL search params with debounced updates.
limit.defaultLimitDesc: Writes to the "limit" search param by default.
limit.customOptionsDesc: Writes to the "perPage" search param with a custom set of values.
limit.currentParamsDesc: URL updates are debounced by {ms}ms after each selection.
limit.noParamsHint: No search params set yet. Pick a limit above to update the URL.

reset.title: Reset Filters
reset.description: Clear selected search params from the URL in one action.
reset.toolbarDesc: Reset removes "q", "status", "limit", and "page" from the URL.
reset.currentParamsDesc: Reset is disabled until at least one managed param is present.
reset.noParamsHint: No search params set yet. Change a filter above to update the URL.
